entry.name: jit.conway
entry.description: Performs Conway's Game of Life (a cellular automata function) on incoming 1- or 4-plane character matrices.

attributes.name: birthmark
attributes.digest: Newborn cells value
attributes.description: Defines whether newborn cells are set to 255 (off) or to the average of the contributing neighbor cells (on) (default = 0).

attributes.name: color

attributes.name: deathmask
attributes.digest: Dead-to-live cell mask
attributes.description: A mask setting whether a given number of live (non-0) neighbors will make a dead (0) cell come to life (default = 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 0 0). The first element in the list is the mask value for 0 live neighbors.

attributes.digest: Keep-alive mask
attributes.description: A mask setting whether a given number of live (non-0) neighbors will keep a live (non-0) cell alive (default = 0 0 1 1 0 0 0 0 0). The first element in the list is the mask value for 0 live neighbors.

attributes.name: neighborhood
attributes.digest: Neighbor selection mask
attributes.description: A mask for which neighbors around a cell are tallied to determine whether the cell changes state (default = 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1). Ordering is upper-left, upper, upper-right, left, right, lower-left, lower, lower-right.
